# FlashInfer SM120 sparse MLA headers

This directory is the `attention/sparse_mla_sm120` header subset from
FlashInfer Python 0.6.14, used by the local vLLM 0.26.0 DeepSeek-V4 reference
environment.  The files are vendored unchanged and are compiled only by
FastLLM's optional SM120 sparse-MLA translation unit.

These NVIDIA-authored files carry the BSD 3-Clause license.  See `LICENSE`.
The rest of FastLLM's older FlashInfer snapshot is documented separately in
`third_party/flashinfer/README.md`.
